title: Bump storage to 1.25.0, image 5.42.0, common 0.70.0, and Skopeo v1.25.0
body:
This vendors in:

c/storage  v1.65.0
c/image     v5.42.0
c/common v0.70.0

and then Skope to v0.70.0.  Skopeo will go out with Podman v6.2.0

This is pulling in a lot more than I anticipated, and is bumping to go 1.26.0
